relations: Tracking the van keeps it centered while the yellow truss bridge and lower grey deck slide laterally past.
Pedestrians on the footway change position relative to the van, drifting right and emerging from the left.
The forested cliff and broad tree shift toward the right edge relative to the van's steady center.
Waterfall spray thickens along the left edge while passengers maintain their leaning poses in the van windows.
caption: The video captures a yellow steel truss bridge crossing the frame, with a white tour van lettered 'Bumpy Travels' on its deck. Passengers lean from its side and rear windows while pedestrians are visible on the footway beside the railing. Behind the bridge, a forested cliff rises under pale mist, topped by a broad tree shifting toward the right edge. The van remains near center as the truss, a lamppost, and the hillside slide past, creating a tracking shot of the van. Pedestrians change position relative to the van, with some figures drifting right and others appearing from the left near an emerging covered viewing platform. The lower grey deck and supports also move through the view, reinforcing lateral motion across the scene. Waterfall spray hangs and thickens along the left edge as the passengers hold their poses.
